summary: On 2026-09-21 AMD rose 9.9% to a record, topping $1T market cap, on a reported 10% Q4 chip price hike, record Korean chip exports and US-China export hopes. It announced an $8.2B World Labs stock deal 9/28. The 10/2 gap-up was a sector rally.
support_reason: AI data-center demand, supply-constrained sales and price increases are fundamental; the size and speed of the move look momentum-driven.
dilution_or_offering: $8.2B all-stock World Labs acquisition (8-K 9/28) is modest dilution; no offering
